settings.title: KRAKEN PRO
settings.subtitle: Ergonomic support for every body
settings.text: Kraken Pro eliminates the limits of ordinary chairs with greater adjustability, balanced support, and long-lasting comfort. Engineered for gamers, creators, and hybrid professionals, it delivers posture-perfect ergonomics backed by premium materials and rigorous testing.

settings.left_text: A curved backrest and dynamic lumbar support work together to maintain your spine’s natural alignment, easing lower-back tension and fatigue.
settings.right_text: High-density foam evenly distributes weight to reduce pressure on your thighs and legs, keeping you supported through every posture.

settings.title:
Dynamic lumbar support
Your lumbar has found its match.
settings.text: Engineered with a floating lumbar system, Kraken Pro lets you fine-tune and lock the support at your ideal position. It delivers steady, customized comfort through every posture, from focused work to intense gaming.

settings.title: Adapts to every moment that defines your day
settings.text: Switch from productivity to play to downtime without missing a beat. The chair’s flexible ergonomics ensure comfort and balance in every posture.

settings.title:
4-way dynamic armrest
precise arm support to relieve shoulder and arm stress
settings.text: Our 4-way dynamic armrests are engineered to support your natural posture, moving seamlessly in every direction to reduce stress on your muscles and joints. These armrests provide perfect alignment to keep you supported and comfortable.
settings.text_3: Adapts to your motion, sustains support all day

settings.title: Ultra-Soft Memory Foam
settings.text: Why settle for hard, uncomfortable foam when our ultra-soft memory foam cradles you in cloud-like comfort while delivering the perfect balance of softness and support, keeping you comfortable and focused for years to come.

settings.title: Comfort without limits
settings.text: Tested to endure and built to adapt, the chair’s robust structure and responsive ergonomics ensure seamless comfort and posture balance across all body shapes and sizes.

settings.left_text: Tired of strapped headrest that is always misplace? Snap ours on and slide to your comfort zone.
settings.right_text: Now featuring KGS factory gas lifts, SGS certified, and offering up to class 4 pressure. With top-tier materials and exceptional performance in load support, drop, rotation, and impact tests, it’s built for long-lasting durability.

settings.title: 5-year extended warranty*
settings.text_1: Every component that goes into your Blacklyte gaming chair has been tested beyond industry standards for durability and reliability. We spend a lot of time making sure that our chairs continue to perform even after years of daily use. That’s why we’re standing behind them with up to a 5-year Extended Warranty, so you know we’ve got your back.
settings.tip_1: * Receive a complimentary 2-year extension for a total warranty period of 5 years when you share a picture of your Blacklyte chair. Learn more about our Extended 5-Year Warranty programme here.

settings.heading: 1. What makes the Kraken Pro one of the best gaming chairs?
settings.content: The Kraken Pro combines advanced ergonomic engineering, premium materials, and superior adjustability. Its reinforced steel frame and high-density memory foam deliver lasting comfort, making it one of the best gaming chairs for serious players and professionals alike.

settings.heading: 2. Who should consider the Kraken Pro gaming chairs?
settings.content: It’s ideal for competitive players, streamers, and professionals who spend extended periods seated and value stability, flexibility, and total body support.

settings.heading: 3. How does the Kraken Pro support posture and reduce fatigue?
settings.content: Its 4D armrests, adjustable lumbar support, and reclining backrest align with your natural posture, helping reduce lower-back tension and neck strain during long sessions.

settings.heading: 4. Can the Kraken Pro be used as an office chair?
settings.content: Absolutely. With its ergonomic backrest, adjustable tilt, and plush seat cushioning, the Kraken Pro functions equally well as a professional office chair for productivity and comfort.

settings.heading: 5. What makes the Kraken Pro different from other comfortable gaming chairs?
settings.content: The Kraken Pro stands out as one of the most comfortable gaming chairs thanks to its advanced ergonomic design, precise adjustability, and reinforced metal frame. Built with premium-grade materials, it delivers superior durability and long-lasting comfort for intense gaming sessions or long hours of work.

settings.heading: 6. Does the Kraken Pro gaming chair come with a warranty?
settings.content: Every Kraken Pro includes a 3-year warranty, just like all Blacklyte gaming chairs. You can also join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a €10 cashback.
